newsitem.title: USA: Royal Bancshares ups qtly divs by 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bancshares ups qtly divs by 20 pct.

text.p: Royal Bancshares of Pennsylvania said Friday it has increased the cash dividend on its Class A and Class B common stock by 20 percent over the previous quarter.
On its Class A shares, the company has set a cash dividend of $0.18 per share. For holders of Class B common stock, the cash dividend has been set at $0.2070 per share.
The record date is July 31.The payment date for the cash dividend is August 15.
Royal Bancshares of Pennsylvania is the parent company of Royal Bank of Pennsylvania, a community bank with thirteen offices in southeastern Pennsylvania.
